paper_title: First constraints on QCD axion dark matter using James Webb Space Telescope observations
notes: Constraints on axion-photon coupling from JWST blank-sky observations (MIRI: 0.1-0.5 eV, NIRSpec: 0.5-4 eV). Only a figure (Fig. 2) shows the exclusion curves; no numerical table of the limit was provided. Data points are approximate estimates read from the figure axis range (y-axis spans 1e-13 to 1e-9 GeV^-1). DM density rho_s = 0.18 GeV/cm^3 (NFW). 95% CL. Values are rough and should be refined from the actual plotted curves. | selector: text (sole candidate)
